correctness.rationale: Rotation weights force exactly F(z)=z(a+b|z|²) in degree at most three. Direct Cartesian differentiation gives det DF=m+4cs+3ds². Completing the square for c<0 proves the strict necessary-and-sufficient global C-infinity diffeomorphism parameter boundary; necessity is nonsingular Jacobian, sufficiency is proper strictly monotone radius and bijective angular rotation. The fixed-radius quadratic has one positive solution, giving all-radius basin/escape and rigid circle rotation, exact radial multiplier, and unique-fixed condition. The period-two rational and all-period root-of-unity realizations, degree minimum, and full SO(2) linear centralizer are proved algebraically. The finite independent `verify.py` is corroboration only.
